root.NOTE: This XML file should only be used for documentation purposes.

property.name: SelectedHSVColor
property.comment: Gets or sets the selected color. The value is an array with: H, S, V and Alpha.

method.name: IndexOf
method.comment: Returns the index of the item with the given value. Returns -1 if not found.

property.name: SelectedIndex
property.comment: Gets or sets the selected index

property.name: SelectedItem
property.comment: Gets the selected item. Returns an empty string if nothing is selected.

property.name: Date
property.comment: Gets or sets the selected date

method.name: ShowTemplate
method.comment: Example: Dim options As B4XListTemplate options.Initialize options.Options = Array("Cat", "Dog", "Fish", "Crocodile") Wait For (Dialog.ShowTemplate(options, "OK", "", "CANCEL")) Complete (Result As Int) If Result = xui.DialogResponse_Positive Then Dialog.Show($"You selected: ${options.SelectedItem}"$, "OK", "", "") End If

method.name: GetButton
method.comment: Returns one of the Yes, No or Cancel buttons.

method.name: SetButtonState
method.comment: Sets the enabled state of a button.

class.name: B4XFloatTextField
class.event: TextChanged (Old As String, New As String)

method.name: Update
method.comment: Call after changing the hint properties

method.name: RequestFocusAndShowKeyboard
method.comment: Requests focus and shows the keyboard (the keyboard feature is only relevant to B4A).

property.name: NextField
property.comment: Gets or sets the next field that will be focused when enter or accept button are pressed.

property.name: TextField
property.comment: Gets the native text field. It will be an EditText in B4A, a TextField or TextArea in B4J and a TextField or TextView in B4i.

method.name: Load
method.comment: Loads a bitmap. It uses LoadBitmapSample in B4A to avoid loading larger than necessary images.

property.name: RoundedImage
property.comment: Gets or sets whether to make the image rounded.

property.name: CornersRadius
property.comment: Gets or sets whether to make the image rounded.

property.name: ResizeMode
property.comment: Gets or sets the resize mode. One of the following values: FIT, FILL, FILL_NO_DISTORTIONS, FILL_WIDTH, FILL_HEIGHT, NONE All modes except of FILL respect the image ratio. In most cases it is better not to use FILL.

method.name: SetBorderColor
method.comment: Sets the border color for the valid and invalid states.

method.name: SetItems
method.comment: Builds the index and returns an object which you can store as a process global variable in order to avoid rebuilding the index when the device orientation changes. Consider setting PrefixOnly to True if the list is large. It will be significantly faster.

method.name: SetIndex
method.comment: Sets the index from the previously stored index.

method.name: AddStubToCLVIfNeeded
method.comment: adds a stub item to CLV to fill the ScrollView.

method.name: SetTextOrCSBuilderToLabel
method.comment: Sets text or CSBuilder to a label.

method.name: SetBitmapAndFill
method.comment: Sets a bitmap and sets the gravity to Fill.

method.name: CreateB4XImageView
method.comment: Creates a B4XImageView. You need to add B4XImageView.mBase to the layout tree.
